family: low-nibble 0x?7 (fence / memory / subgroup / atomic / shift-bitfield / convert)
host: LOCAL M4, COMPILE-ONLY (no GPU dispatch): compile own MSL -> extract -> tokenize -> byte-diff
summary: Decoded the genuinely-undecoded members of the low-nibble-0x7 space. The inflated census gap counts (0x17 fam ~281, 0x27 fam ~247, 0x07 desync ~261) were dominated by DOWNSTREAM residue from upstream non-0x7 mis-lengths (n2/n9/nb/n3), not real 0x7 ops: restricting to ALIGNED-only ops closed the true aligned 0x?7 gaps from 180 -> 29 (151 ops newly named). Two real 0x?7 length-rule desyncs were fixed: the 0x27 shift-left-by-register op (byte+1==0x20) and the 0x67 threadgroup atomic_exchange (byte+2==0x56). A pre-existing ishift roundtrip bug (byte+5 uncovered) was also fixed.

lengthRules.change: ADD gate: byte+2 in {0x54,0x56} AND byte+8 in {0xc0,0xf0} -> 12 (ibfins).
lengthRules.why: closes the k_bfi_dyn shl-by-reg mis-length (old else->8 branch orphaned the operand tail into a 0xf0 desync cascade). PROVEN SAFE: every genuine 8-byte 0x27 op (iunary/popcount/ibitcount/ctz) has byte+8 in {0x02,0x1f,0xe7} -- never 0xc0/0xf0.

lengthRules.change: RELAX threadgroup-atomic gate (byte+1==0x03) from byte+2==0x54 to byte+2 in {0x54,0x56} -> 12.
lengthRules.why: atomic_exchange(threadgroup) emits byte+2==0x56 (source cache-hint bit set); old ==0x54 gate missed it -> generic 0x67->14 over-read by 2 -> the k_atomics_tg_xchg desync.

descriptors.semantics: d = shift-left / bitfield-insert (integer). The byte0-bit7 LEFT/INSERT mirror of the 0xa7 ibfe (right/extract) family -- shl_reg (`27 10 54 ..`) is byte-identical to shr_log (`a7 10 54 ..`) except byte0. 12-byte operand-descriptor form (byte+8 = 0xf0 register / 0xc0 immediate). byte+1 (form) selects the sub-op: 0x10 = logical shift-left by a register amount; 0x00 = the bitfield-INSERT (insert_bits) / mask / narrowing-convert merge helper (dominant form); 0x02 = an address / matrix-load-index computation on the same datapath; 0x20/0x11 = variable-operand merge forms. byte+2 bit1 (cache) = the source last-use/cache hint shared with the reduce/shuffle families (0x54 vs 0x56).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (own-MSL): the shl_reg(0x27)/shr_log(0xa7) 12-byte ops are byte-identical except byte0 -> byte0 bit7 = direction, and byte0 0x27 = the shift-LEFT / bitfield-INSERT sibling of the HW-validated 0xa7 ibfe (EXP-0013). Emitted by our own shl_reg / insert_bits / funnel_shift / narrowing-convert kernels. Length 12 (operand-tail byte+8 in {0xc0,0xf0}) closes the k_bfi_dyn `27 20 54` mis-length desync. Field bit-packing and the byte+1 form map are byte-diff INFERRED (no GPU dispatch); direction is diff-proven.

descriptors.semantics: THREADGROUP (shared-memory) atomic read-modify-write. byte0 0x67 load/store family with the threadgroup variant byte+1==0x03 (device atomics are byte+1 0x11/0x01, 14 B). Operation = the 5-bit op field at bits[86:91]: 16 add, 17 and, 18 compare-exchange, 21 smin, 22 or, 27 sub, 28 umax, 29 umin, 30 exchange, 31 xor. byte+3 (ret) 0x03 = return-old-value form, 0x00 = no-return (fire-and-forget) / cmpxchg; byte+8 = 0x22 RMW-with-return, 0x20 no-return, 0x02 cmpxchg/xchg. Like the device atomic_rmw this is a single native op preceded by a simd_reduce lane-combine, NOT a CAS retry loop. atomic_exchange emits the byte+2==0x56 cache-hint variant.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (own-MSL): op-select localised to bits[86:91] by diffing our own tg_u_{add,sub,and,or,xor,max,min}/tg_s_min/tg_u_{cmpxchg,xchg,add_noret} kernels (each pair differs only in the operation) -- every op maps to a distinct value with all other bytes held constant. Length 12 (byte+1==0x03, byte+2 in {0x54,0x56}) closes the k_atomics_tg_xchg `67 03 56` over-read desync. NOT HW-dispatch-validated (compile+diff only); the device sibling atomic_rmw IS HW-validated (EXP-0018) and shares the model.

descriptors.semantics: fragment tilebuffer / attachment READ (byte+1==0x06). The plain-read sibling of tile_read (0x0e programmable-blend) and imageblock_load (0x16 first-access). Reads the current colour-attachment / imageblock slice into a GPR for MRT programmable blend and per-sample blend; byte+3 = destination GPR, byte+5 = render-target / imageblock-slice selector, byte+7 = slot format (0x0e half4 / 0x8e signed).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (own-MSL): the byte+1==0x06 read variant present in our own blend_mrt_rw / per_sample_blend / tile_imageblock fragment kernels; field layout mirrors the HW-validated tile_read (EXP-0029). No isolated GPU dispatch for this variant (compile+diff); the 0x0e/0x16 siblings ARE HW-validated and share the field model.

descriptors.semantics: texture COORDINATE-PROJECTION / sample-address / gradient SETUP feeding a following tex_sample. 12-byte form of the 0x17 group; byte+1 (form) 0x01 = coordinate projection (cube/array/depth-compare coordinate assembly), 0x05 = sample-address / gradient descriptor (MSAA sample index, explicit-grad LOD). Emitted immediately before the sampler op in our texcube / tex2darray / tex_ms / tex_depth_cmp / grad_cube kernels. byte+2 bit1 = source cache/last-use hint (0x54/0x56).
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (own-MSL): present (12-byte, byte+1 in {0x01,0x05}) directly before the tex_sample in our own cube/array/MSAA/depth-compare/grad texture kernels; length 12 is the instr_length rule (EXP-M4-12). Field roles byte-diff INFERRED / structural -- no isolated GPU dispatch (this host is compile-only). The tex_sample it feeds IS HW-validated (EXP-0016/0037).

modifiedDescriptors.irotate: byte+2 match ==0x56 -> {0x54,0x56}; names the cache-clear rotate form (27 01 54) as irotate.
modifiedDescriptors.cvt_i2f: byte+1 match ==0x07 -> low-nibble 7 ((8,4,7)) + new srcsel field (byte+1 hi-nibble) to name the 0x17 sibling convert; cvtop byte+6 width-descriptor enum extended {0xa0,0xa4,0xa8,0xac,0xb4,0x8e} (byte-diff of our i/u {8,16,32}->f{16,32} kernels).
modifiedDescriptors.ibitcount: ADDED byte+1 bit1==0 ((9,1,0)) so it no longer collides with cvt_i2f/cvt_f2i (byte+1 low-nib7 => bit1=1); byte+2 relaxed ==0x56 -> {0x54,0x56} to name the cache-clear reverse_bits/find-MSB siblings (a7 04/05 54).
modifiedDescriptors.ishift: BUGFIX (pre-existing): srcdst field widened 16->24 bits to cover byte+5; every ishift with byte+5 != 0 previously FAILED asm(disasm(b))==b (30 corpus ops now pass).

notes: byte0 bit7 = shift/bitfield DIRECTION (left/insert 0x27 vs right/extract 0xa7): shl_reg `27 10 54 ..` is BYTE-IDENTICAL to shr_log `a7 10 54 ..` except byte0 -- a clean byte-diff proof. The 0x54/0x56 byte+2 pair is the ISA-wide source cache/last-use hint (bit1). The threadgroup atomic op is a 5-bit field split across the byte10/11 boundary (byte+10 bits6-7 ++ byte+11 bits0-2), byte-diff-mapped across 11 own tg_* kernels. The residual clean-tokenization bottleneck is OTHER families (falu3/n9, ilogic/nb, icmpsel/n2), NOT low-nibble-7.
provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R2 (own-MSL, COMPILE-ONLY host). Every encoding learned by compiling our own MSL, extracting AGX bytes, and byte-diffing controlled single-variable pairs. NO GPU dispatch (this host has no reboot escape) -> nothing is re-claimed HW-splice-validated; where a fact rests on an earlier HW-validated sibling (atomic_rmw EXP-0018, ibfe/cvt EXP-0013, tile_read/tex_sample EXP-0016/0029) that lineage is cited per descriptor. NO Apple binary was inspected.

corpus_allops_roundtrip.note: the 68 falu3 failures are PRE-EXISTING low-nibble-9 (NOT this family); a separate proposal (proposals_r2/fix_falu3_ishift.json) addresses them.

unresolved.why: fragment per-sample / coverage setup op; needs a RENDER dispatch to vary sample-mask inputs and characterize -- impossible on this compile-only host. Length 10 (falls through 0x17 -> 10) is correct (tokenizes), only the descriptor/op-select is unknown.
mesh-stage attribute/index setup; needs mesh dispatch.
RT/fragment scoreboard-fence & tile-access micro-ops in the 0x07/0x87 fence family; length is handled but the exact scope/flag field roles need RT-query or render dispatch to separate.
rare 1-off forms; several are downstream of a preceding n2/nb desync (not confidently aligned).

the sg_product lowering is a log2(32)-step shuffle(0x47)+multiply tree; individual 0x47 ops in it carry per-step operands the simple simd_shuffle descriptor does not model. RT-query getters need a ray-query object (RT dispatch) to provoke. Both are largely DOWNSTREAM residue in the census (the aligned count is small).
